description: This file contains functions for calculating Transport Block Size (TBS) and Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) configurations for 5G NR uplink and downlink channels, including helper functions for rate validation and configuration building.

methods.name: build_ulsch_info
methods.description: Constructs a ulsch_configuration object with parameters for effective code rate calculation based on PUSCH configuration and other parameters.

methods.name: update_ulsch_info
methods.description: Updates a ulsch_configuration object with new TBS and MCS information.

methods.name: calculate_min_uci_bits
methods.description: Calculates the minimum number of rate-matched bits required for UCI messages based on payload size, number of REs, modulation, and layers.

methods.name: is_pusch_effective_rate_valid
methods.description: Checks if the effective code rate for PUSCH transmission is within supported limits and meets minimum UCI bit requirements.
